page.title: Glowcase — Let prospects discover your product before the demo call

findings.title: h2 headings render at 4 different sizes
findings.evidence: “Teach Glowcase about your product. Then let buyers” is 60px while “POWERING PRODUCT DEMOS FOR” is 11px (5.45×). Sizes seen: 11px ×1, 30px ×2, 48px ×8, 60px ×1; weights: 400, 700, 800. Same semantic level should get the same treatment.
findings.fix: Pick one size for h2 and set it once in CSS. If one of these is really a sub-heading, change its tag instead of its size.
findings.citation: UICrit: elements at the same level of hierarchy should get similar graphic treatment (Duan et al., UIST '24)

findings.title: One h3 is a different size from the other 15
findings.evidence: “Let buyers choose what matters to them.” is 24px; the other h3s are 14/18/20px (14px ×3, 18px ×3, 20px ×9, 24px ×1). Same semantic level should get the same treatment.
findings.fix: Pick one size for h3 and set it once in CSS. If one of these is really a sub-heading, change its tag instead of its size.
findings.citation: UICrit: elements at the same level of hierarchy should get similar graphic treatment (Duan et al., UIST '24)

findings.title: Uneven spacing between 5 repeated span items
findings.evidence: Gaps along the horizontal axis are 21, 15, 9, 15px (median 15px, worst deviation 6px).
findings.fix: Use a single gap value on the container (flex/grid gap) instead of per-item margins.

findings.title: 5 different corner radii on panels
findings.evidence: Radii in use on ≥80px panels: 12px, 16px, 20px, 32px, 40px. A system usually needs two or three.
findings.fix: Define --radius-sm / --radius-md / --radius-lg tokens and use only those.

findings.title: Head is missing: title is 67 chars (cuts off ~60)
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD structured data either, so AI search engines have nothing to cite. One h1, good.
findings.fix: Ten minutes of <head> work: title under 60 chars, canonical URL, lang attribute, favicon, and an Organization or WebSite JSON-LD block.

findings.title: 106 words under 12px on a phone
findings.evidence: 24 text blocks render below 12px at 390px, e.g. h2#brand-proof-heading.text-center.text-[11px] “Powering product demos for” at 11px.
findings.fix: Body text 16px on mobile; nothing readable under 12px. If the desktop size is in px, use clamp() or a mobile breakpoint.

findings.title: 4 cards nested inside other cards
findings.evidence: 4 outer containers with bordered/shadowed children, e.g. div.absolute.bottom-4 inside div.relative.mx-auto. Every layer of box is a layer the reader has to look through.
findings.fix: Remove the inner border/background and separate items with spacing or a divider. One container per idea.
findings.citation: UXly nested-panel (MIT); Fountain Institute tell #5; Reinecke 2013: visual complexity is the strongest negative predictor of appeal

findings.title: 24 rounded panels on one page
findings.evidence: Rounded corners on every container is one of the ranked vibe-coded tells (#5 in the Reddit corpus).
findings.fix: Round the things that are interactive or elevated; let sections and layout containers stay square.

findings.title: Eyebrow label above the hero headline
findings.evidence: “Interactive product demos” (11px, tracked caps) sits directly above a 60px h1. The tiny label + giant headline pairing is the default generated SaaS hero.
findings.fix: Fold the label into the headline or the first sentence. If it's an announcement, make it a real link somewhere else.

findings.title: 7 untouched shadcn/ui cards
findings.evidence: Class strings like “w-64 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-3” are the component library's defaults, unmodified. Fine as scaffolding; as the final look it's tell #1.
findings.fix: Change the tokens (radius, border colour, shadow) once in your theme so the components stop looking like the docs page.

findings.title: 21 tracked all-caps section labels
findings.evidence: Small uppercase, letter-spaced labels like “Interactive product demos” above sections. On 10.5% of Show HN launches, and usually redundant with the heading under them.
findings.fix: Delete the label or fold its word into the heading.

findings.title: “How it works” in 4 numbered steps
findings.evidence: 4 siblings each lead with a number in a badge. The three-step setup strip was on 9% of Show HN launches; on a landing page it usually says less than one screenshot would.
findings.fix: Replace with the actual product: a screenshot, a 10-second clip, or the real command to run.
